limitations: released Atari57 trace counts vary by game; all available traces retained
published online curves, not our frozen evaluations; compare online separately
Atari100k uses a different nonsticky/minimal-action protocol and smaller interaction budget
Kindle pixel pipeline/reset noops/episode caps/model size and replay recipe are not exact paper replicas
reference lacks comparable same-hardware wall time; no compute-speedup inference from model size alone
Three development seeds; bootstrap intervals are coarse and no suite-wide confidence claim is made.
The 200k decisions per learner are about 800k frames: more than Atari100k, less than Atari57.
Last-50 episode online scores and published frame bins have different averaging windows.
Exploration was developed on Freeway; this study is not an independent Freeway replication.
No same-protocol same-hardware RGB control for this five-game action-effects package.
Totals include these 15 learners and 30 evaluations, not earlier development/reference/pretraining costs.
Videos are whole deterministic stream-zero replays; original online pixels were not hashed.
